text:
Sam: quick midday async — what I shipped: adjusted batch window 8ms->12ms on canary shard (PR #4823). Saw ~3–5% p95 improvement on short prompts. Next up: cross-shard microbench and kv prefetch tuning. Blocker: can't repro cold-start misses on local sim, env mismatch maybe. Who can run perf rig on staging? @Riley
Riley: I can spin up the perf rig in ~30m. Which model + promptset do you want me to use?
Sam: use gptx-7b-qa, promptset `small-qc-v2` (https://go/internal/promptsets/small-qc-v2). Run 1k requests with burst profile, measure p95 and token-tail >128.
Maya: re: KV prefetch — pushed a tiny tweak to lower prefetch threshold to 40 tokens (PR #4831). Should cut unnecessary priming without hurting warmups. Will watch cache-hit.
Jordan: left comments on 4823 — increasing batch window can cause slot contention. Recommend adding a soft slot-throttle at 75% util during canary to reduce slot-stealing.
ops-bot: perf-rig job started by Riley — job id rig-2026-04-02-09. Estimated runtime ~45m.
Liam: quick CR on 4823: looks good but needs a unit test for microbatch timing edge. I can add a small test tomorrow morning.
Sam: great — Riley ping when rig finishes and upload artifacts. Maya, if cache hit dips <60% abort canary and revert prefetch. :thumbsup:
Riley: rig finished — quick numbers: baseline p95 120ms -> canary p95 112ms; tail (tokens>128) CPU +2%. Observed KV misses spike at t0 on some shards. Artifacts uploaded: https://go/internal/rig/artifacts/rig-2026-04-02-09
Sam: nice win on p95. I'll collate results and open a cross-shard warmup issue. Blockers resolved for today. Thanks everyone.
Maya: noted — I'll add a dashboard alert for KV-miss spikes during canary windows.
Jordan: filing a short follow-up to add slot-throttle and a canary playbook step.
Liam: will draft the unit test PR tomorrow.
Sam: done — created issue INF-1289 to track warmup + throttles. Closing loop here. :raised_hands:
